semiconductor_relevance: High — Kitagawa Seiki specializes in vacuum multi-stage presses essential for forming copper-clad laminates used in printed circuit boards.
summary: Kitagawa Seiki is a leader in manufacturing vacuum multi-stage presses that are critical for the production of copper-clad laminates, which serve as core layers in printed circuit boards. Their equipment supports both small-scale R&D and large-scale production, enabling effective prototyping and testing of new products.
capabilities: Vacuum multi-stage presses for copper-clad laminate formation
Hot-cold press equipment for prototype testing
Press/laminator equipment for substrate molding and bonding
